set.body:
Completed bounded qualification of independent-subject scalar nuisance contrasts, with a reusable production design-review API. Exact candidates: equal-subject OLS identity-target CR2/Satterthwaite, and null-restricted Rademacher wild bootstrap using HC2 restricted residual adjustment and HC2 studentization. Initial protocol lodged before pilot; subsequent scope decision kept failed inferential candidates in tools, not production defaults.

Acceptance: independent R/NumPy action/formula parity; fixed-design nonzero nuisance, imbalance, unequal variance, normal/t3/skew, marginal variance boundaries; 216000 pilot plus 160000 fresh confirmation studies; full shifted-null coverage, power and finite-p checks; simultaneous calibration failure regressions. Both tested candidates remain unadmitted as general defaults. General nuisance/F/weighted/spatial inference is not completed by this child.

Production: GroupContrastDiagnostics.review reuses Gale preparation and named contrast alignment, preserving subject identity, leverage, signed standardized contrast influence, identity-working variance shares, residual df and working information; unit leverage is explicit/unavailable. No p-values, no default change. Tests: 293 executions across JVM/JS group and workflow; 18 R df fixtures plus invariances/refusals. Native export and nine sequential review benchmark forks; inspected/refined static figure. Evidence: docs/verification/group-nuisance-2026-09-08.md and matching json.gz; tools/group-nuisance. Local candidate over 72a35a46df661e6e8b0e8dd6bd7dbb59002ec9e4, 65 native/candidate Scala source matches. App provider adoption/UI and broader inference remain open.
set.title: Qualify nuisance candidates and expose subject-bound contrast diagnostics
